purpose: three-slot exact identification of T, K, F on the hidden label set; see knowledge/02_the_ceiling_and_the_instrument.md section 6

gems32-probe-S1-ANCHOR-identical-to-live.construction: bit-identical in-footprint values to the anchor; re-encoded all-finite with no nodata tag
gems32-probe-S1-ANCHOR-identical-to-live.expected_relation_to_anchor: leaderboard score should reproduce the anchor's

gems32-probe-S2-SCALE-lambda-0.5.tif.construction: lambda = 0.5 applied to every positive value of S1

gems32-probe-S3-NULLADD-2000px.tif.construction: S1 plus 2000 unit-mass pixels placed at the maximum of min(distance-to-anchor-support, distance-to-catalogue, distance-to-footprint-edge), mutually >= 6 px apart
gems32-probe-S3-NULLADD-2000px.tif.expected_relation_to_anchor: strictly BELOW S1 by ~alpha*2000/T in 1/DTI; only the best submission counts toward standing

decision_rule.then: report the measured hidden-set recall T/K, and re-price every subsequent emission decision on the measured K instead of the owner model K_hat = 12,226
decision_rule.residual_risk: if any S3 probe pixel lands within 300 m of a hidden fault then dT>0 and T is over-estimated; mitigation is the >=4 px catalogue clearance and the maximum-distance placement, and the risk is bounded by the fact that probes are at the minimum of every belief field in the repository
